flightRules.title: Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly Desiccant Bed Thermal Regeneration
flightRules.verbatim_text:
# Operational Flight Rule: FR-CDRA-002

## Operating Condition & Context
During cyclic thermal desorption of CDRA desiccant and zeolite adsorbent beds, differential pressure anomalies across the selector valve or bed core temperatures exceeding nominal limits indicate thermal boundary excursion or bed channeling.

## Procedural Contingency Checklist

| Step | Action | Target Subsystem | Verification | Caution / Warning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Isolate regenerative heating loop on affected bed | CDRA-HEAT | Power telemetry HEATER_A_PWR == 0 W | Do not touch manifold lines; surface temperature exceeds 200 degC |
| 2 | Engage secondary cabin return air bypass loop | NOD2-AIR | BYPASS_V22 position confirmed OPEN | Airflow drop across desiccant bed expected |
| 3 | Initiate vacuum desorption purge for 20 minutes | CDRA-VAC | Vacuum valve V12 OPEN, P_VAC < 0.05 torr | Monitor cabin pressure for unexpected air loss |
| 4 | Re-evaluate bed delta-P before resuming automatic cycle | CDRA-METRICS | DELTA_P <= 0.8 psi | If delta-P persists above 1.2 psi, lock out Bed B |

checklist_steps.action: Isolate regenerative heating loop on affected bed
checklist_steps.caution_warning: Do not touch manifold lines; surface temperature exceeds 200 degC

checklist_steps.action: Engage secondary cabin return air bypass loop
checklist_steps.caution_warning: Airflow drop across desiccant bed expected

checklist_steps.action: Initiate vacuum desorption purge for 20 minutes
checklist_steps.verification: Vacuum valve V12 OPEN, P_VAC < 0.05 torr
checklist_steps.caution_warning: Monitor cabin pressure for unexpected air loss

flightRules.title: Elevated Cabin Carbon Dioxide and Hypercapnia Mitigation
flightRules.verbatim_text:
# Operational Flight Rule: FR-ECLSS-001

## Operating Condition & Context
When cabin partial pressure of CO2 exceeds 4.0 mmHg during crew rest cycles or 5.0 mmHg during active duty, the following procedural checklist must be executed immediately to prevent acute hypercapnia, cognitive impairment, and cephalic fluid shift compounding.

## Procedural Contingency Checklist

| Step | Action | Target Subsystem | Verification | Caution / Warning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Transition CDRA Bed Selector to DUAL-BED HIGH-FLOW | CDRA-ECLSS | Telemetry CDRA_STATE == 0x04 | Ensure vacuum desorb valve V12 is open before switching |
| 2 | Verify cabin ventilation fans running at nominal rate | NOD2-VENT | Flow rate >= 55 CFM | High acoustic noise (>62 dBA) during high-flow operation |
| 3 | Inquire crew for subjective symptoms | CREW-MED | Log headache, vision blurring, dyspnea | Prepare backup LiOH canisters if CDRA delta-P > 1.2 psi |
| 4 | Deploy portable LiOH auxiliary scrubber if P_CO2 > 6.0 mmHg | AUX-SCRUB | Auxiliary latch confirmed | Emergency flight director notification mandatory |

checklist_steps.action: Transition CDRA Bed Selector to DUAL-BED HIGH-FLOW
checklist_steps.caution_warning: Ensure vacuum desorb valve V12 is open before switching

checklist_steps.action: Verify cabin ventilation fans running at nominal rate
checklist_steps.caution_warning: High acoustic noise (>62 dBA) during high-flow operation
Prepare backup LiOH canisters if CDRA delta-P > 1.2 psi

checklist_steps.action: Deploy portable LiOH auxiliary scrubber if P_CO2 > 6.0 mmHg

flightRules.title: Extravehicular Activity Autonomic Strain and Tachycardia Mitigation
flightRules.condition_threshold: HR >= 160 bpm or RMSSD <= 15 ms during EVA prep
flightRules.verbatim_text:
# Operational Flight Rule: FR-EVA-003

## Operating Condition & Context
Sustained sympathetic hyperactivation (heart rate exceeding 160 bpm or RMSSD dropping below 15 ms for greater than 5 consecutive minutes) during airlock pre-breathe or spacesuit donning signals acute autonomic decompensation, exhaustion, or impending vasovagal collapse.

## Procedural Contingency Checklist

| Step | Action | Target Subsystem | Verification | Caution / Warning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 1 | Halt spacesuit donning protocol and direct crew to rest position | AIRLOCK-OPS | Suit umbilical motion stopped | Do not depressurize airlock while heart rate is elevated |
| 2 | Switch EMU oxygen regulator to 100% O2 high-flow flush | EMU-O2 | O2 supply pressure >= 850 psi | Check for hyperoxic euphoria symptoms |
| 3 | Instruct crewmember to initiate paced 4-4 breathing cycle | CREW-MED | Real-time RMSSD telemetry trending upward | Ground flight surgeon audio consultation required |
| 4 | Abort EVA preparation if heart rate does not decrease below 120 bpm within 15 min | FLIGHT-DIR | Mission Director notification logged | Mandatory 24-hour stand-down for affected crewmember |

checklist_steps.action: Halt spacesuit donning protocol and direct crew to rest position
checklist_steps.caution_warning: Do not depressurize airlock while heart rate is elevated

checklist_steps.action: Switch EMU oxygen regulator to 100% O2 high-flow flush
Instruct crewmember to initiate paced 4-4 breathing cycle
checklist_steps.caution_warning: Ground flight surgeon audio consultation required

checklist_steps.action: Abort EVA preparation if heart rate does not decrease below 120 bpm within 15 min
